Before you give

A few things
to know.

Who can use a certificate?

Certificates can be given to an individual or a couple, whether they are new to We Dance or already attend the studio.

Can I choose another amount?

Yes. Contact the studio to arrange a certificate in your preferred amount.

How do I buy one?

Choose Bronze, Silver or Gold above to open the studio’s Stripe payment page. You can also visit or contact the studio for help.

How do I arrange the lessons?

Speak with the studio about the recipient’s interests, available lessons and using the certificate.
